correct.zh: 正确答案是ウ「软件安装部署」。软件安装部署是指把做好的软件产品装入实际使用的环境、使其达到可用状态的工序。具体来说，就是把软件安装到目标硬件或服务器上，创建数据库并录入初始数据，并按照合同（需求）指定的方式设置用户账号、连接目标、各种参数等。像这样一直做到搭建好运行环境（可以正式运行的环境）为止，都属于安装部署的工作范围，与题干中「按照合同指定的方式进行初始设置，并搭建运行环境」的说明准确对应。在软件生存周期过程（JIS X 0160）中，也把开发结束后的软件迁移到目标环境、使其能够运行的活动定义为软件安装部署过程。
correct.en: The correct answer is ウ “Software installation”. Software installation is the process of putting a finished software product into the environment where it will actually be used and bringing it to a usable state. Specifically, the software is installed on the target hardware or server, databases are created and initial data is registered, and user accounts, connection destinations, and various parameters are configured exactly as specified in the contract (requirements). Carrying this through until the execution environment (an environment that can run in production) is ready is the scope of installation work, and it corresponds exactly to the description in the question: performing the initial setup as specified in the contract and preparing the execution environment. The software life cycle processes standard (JIS X 0160) also defines the activity of moving developed software to the target environment and making it operational as the software installation process.

distractors.zh: 软件验收是指订购方（取得方）通过验收测试和评审来检查交付的软件，确认其是否按照需求制作，并予以检验签收的活动。它是在安装部署使系统达到可运行状态之后进行的「判定合格与否」的工序，本身并不是初始设置或搭建运行环境。
distractors.en: Software acceptance is the activity in which the customer (acquirer) inspects the delivered software through acceptance tests and reviews, confirms that it was built according to the requirements, and formally accepts it. It is the step of judging pass or fail, performed after installation has made the system operational; it is not the initial setup or the preparation of the execution environment itself.

distractors.zh: 软件集成是开发工序的一部分，指把已完成单元测试的模块（程序部件）组合起来，通过集成测试确认接口以及模块之间的数据传递是否正确的工作。这是开发方在做出产品的过程中所做的中间工作，与在使用环境中的安装、初始设置处于不同阶段。
distractors.en: Software integration is part of the development process: modules (program components) that have finished unit testing are combined, and integration testing confirms that the interfaces and the data passed between modules are correct. It is work done by the developer while building the product, at a different stage from installing and configuring the product in the environment where it will be used.

distractors.zh: 软件维护是系统开始正式运行之后进行的工序，指持续修正发现的缺陷、应对法规修订和业务变更、改善性能或追加功能等活动。它与在开始运行之前整备环境的安装部署在时间顺序上正好相反，不属于题干所说的工作。
distractors.en: Software maintenance is the process carried out after the system has started production operation: it continuously fixes defects that are found, responds to changes in laws or business operations, improves performance, and adds functions. Its position on the timeline is the reverse of installation, which prepares the environment before operation begins, so it is not the task described in the question.

points.zh: 软件安装部署（安装）是按照合同指定的方式对软件和数据库进行初始设置、搭建运行环境并使其可以运行的工序。要记住它在生存周期上的排列顺序是「开发（含集成）→ 安装部署 → 验收 → 运行 → 维护」。
points.en: Software installation is the process of performing the initial setup of software and databases as specified in the contract, preparing the execution environment, and making the system ready to operate. Remember the life cycle order: development (including integration) → installation → acceptance → operation → maintenance.

points.zh: 相似的术语要用「由谁做」「什么时候做」来区分。集成由开发方在开发过程中进行；安装部署作为运行前的环境整备进行；验收由取得方为检查交付物而进行；维护则在开始运行之后为改良和修正而进行。
points.en: Distinguish similar terms by who performs them and when. Integration is done by the developer during development; installation is done as environment preparation before operation; acceptance is done by the acquirer to inspect the delivered product; maintenance is done after operation has started, for improvements and fixes.
